Hi Maria — thanks for the questions. Adding technical detail below so procurement has exact language.

SOC 2 / Evidence:
- Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II certified (CCPA/ISO-aligned controls) as of 2026-11-15. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA and a redacted control matrix for initial review. The SOC report covers our hosted and dedicated control environments; Private (on-prem) deployments are assessed per-customer during onboarding.

Retention / backups / deletion SLA (detailed):
- Application logs: default 30-day retention. Logs are stored in a write-once bucket for the configured window; archival to long-term storage is available (policy-based). Configurable retention up to 7 years for enterprise subscriptions.
- Backups: incremental backups occur nightly with full snapshots weekly. Standard retention is 90 days.
- Immutable snapshots: supported. For customers opting into archived snapshots we provide immutable (WORM-like) snapshots that cannot be altered or deleted until the retention period expires.
- KMS / CMK: for Private and Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via standard KMS providers. For hosted, CMK/KMS options are available under enterprise agreements. All snapshot and backup objects are encrypted at rest.
- Deletion SLA: upon a valid deletion request for user/tenant data we perform logical deletion within 30 days. Backup/snapshot purge occurs according to the configured retention policy; if an accelerated purge is contractually required we can support an agreed accelerated window with evidence of prune completion (audit log).

Audit & evidence:
- We provide audit logs for snapshot creation/deletion, KMS key usage, and admin access. Audit retention for these events is configurable and can be extended for enterprise contracts.

1) We will prepare: SOC 2 summary (redacted) + control matrix; draft BAA; and a short SLA paragraph with retention numbers for the contract.
2) Stephanie / Ben: please confirm procurement meeting time.
